embedded-page-metadata-01.graded_text: Tessel's own wrapper page emits the icon, title, and link preview tags in its initial server-rendered HTML, taken from the person's HTML when it is saved, rather than relying on the person's script or the inner document.

votes.e: B/project/docs/metadata.md:40 "The wrapper renders on the server. It loads the page and its metadata record in a single lookup, which also decides visibility, and it writes the tags into the initial HTML. Preview tools read only that HTML and run no script."; :20 "Each time a page is published, Tessel parses the HTML on the server without running it and stores a metadata record".

embedded-page-metadata-02.graded_text: Public and unlisted pages get page-specific previews, and unlisted pages keep noindex while still getting their real preview card.

votes.e: B/project/docs/metadata.md:4 "An unlisted page gets a full, real preview card. ... Unlisted pages stay `noindex`."; table :46-49 Unlisted "page values", "page image or generated card", robots "`noindex`".

embedded-page-metadata-03.graded_text: A private page answers any request not authorized for it, link-preview fetchers included, with a generic card that names only the product and carries no title, text, or image from the page.

votes.e: B/project/docs/metadata.md:69 "The server-rendered wrapper for a private page never contains the page's title, description, icon, or image. This holds even when the request carries a valid member session."; :71 "The generic card is the product's own brand card: Tessel's mark, the name \"Tessel\", and nothing about the page."; :72 the preview image URL "returns the generic brand card with `Cache-Control: no-store`" unless the page is public or unlisted.

embedded-page-metadata-04.graded_text: Preview images are rendered in an environment that cannot write saved data or cause other side effects, and cannot reach private or internal networks or credentials, and a page load no person started, such as a link-preview fetcher running the page's script, cannot add saved data such as a poll vote.

votes.e: The no-person-load half holds: B/project/docs/metadata.md:95 "it refuses them until the page has had a user activation" and :96 "The write endpoint rejects requests that have no valid token". The rendering environment is never constrained, though. The only isolation requirement is deferred to a later screenshot option, at :89 "check ... that the renderer is isolated from Tessel credentials". The image inputs are fetched server-side with no address blocking, at :33 "Icons are copied into Tessel storage at publish time, whether they come from a `data:` URL, a file in the page bundle, or an absolute `https:` URL." Nothing says the card generator or this fetcher cannot reach private or internal networks or credentials.

embedded-page-metadata-05.graded_text: A page's own preview image is used when it declares one, and otherwise a preview is generated, so publishing never requires making an image.

votes.e: B/project/docs/metadata.md:82-83 "If the page declares `og:image`, that image is used for public and unlisted pages. Otherwise, Tessel generates a 1200×630 PNG card"; :16 "publishing takes one HTML file with no manifest and no preview image".

blocking: [claude-fallback] Server-side SSRF: at publish time Tessel fetches any author-supplied absolute icon URL into storage (B/project/docs/metadata.md:33 "Icons are copied into Tessel storage at publish time, whether they come from ... an absolute `https:` URL"), and nothing blocks loopback, private, link-local, or cloud-metadata addresses or rechecks redirects. A hostile page can point its icon at internal hosts, and Tessel would fetch and store the response.
